correctness.rationale: All resource rewards are strictly positive and strictly decreasing with use; all execution times are strictly increasing and positive. Exact evaluation yields the four profiles (5/4,5/4), (11/2,eta), (1/2,2), (6,eta). Opponent-dependent best reply comparisons exhaust the four profiles and classify pure equilibria for all eta>0, including equality endpoints. In 5/4<eta<2 the strict better-reply cycle proves nonexistence of pure and ordinal potential; mixed indifference yields q=2/5 and p=4(2-eta)/3, both interior and unique. Perturbation openness follows from nonzero margins and positive denominators. Standalone exact-rational verify.py executed and passed, not replacing infinite-eta proof.

value.rationale: The gap is motivated by the exact recently introduced physical objective J=R/T and a key inferential pitfall: transformed additive potential equilibrium existence does not lift automatically to pure equilibrium of original fractional allocations. The explicit strictly congestion-monotone 3-resource realization isolates the structural interaction of bundling and heterogeneous times, the entire sharp parameter regime, the unique mixed response and its robust four-cycle. These parameter-specific facts are not routine named-formula substitutions or an arbitrary finite enumeration; they identify the boundary for pure decentralized task allocation under an emerging model.
